# New Rally-X for MSX2+ — 1.0.2

The owner-selected final version fits a **768 KiB cartridge/MegaRAM target**.
The programmed cartridge is **761,856 bytes (744 KiB)**. This release also fixes
cartridge and MegaRAM gameplay on **64 KiB fixed main RAM without a RAM mapper**.
Graphics, production audio, native game rules and F10 test mode are preserved.

## Downloads

| File | Hardware and launch |
| --- | --- |
| **newrallyx.rom** | MSX2+/V9958,128 KiB VRAM,64 KiB main RAM. Select **ASCII8**. No main RAM mapper required. |
| **newrallyx-megaram.zip** | Same machine,64 KiB fixed RAM and **at least768 KiB compatible MegaRAM**. MSX-DOS1: `NRXMEGA`; Disk BASIC: `RUN "NRXMEGA.BAS"`. No main RAM mapper required. |
| **newrallyx-disk.zip** | Preserved standard RAM-mapper executable: **4 MiB mapper RAM**, no MegaRAM needed. DOS: `NRALLYX`; BASIC: `RUN "NRALLYX.BAS"`. Contains COM/BIN/BAS/DAT. |
| **newrallyx-1.0.2.json** | Delivery identities, requirements, source commit and publication approval. |
| **newrallyx-qualification.json** | Exact-hash measurement record made before promotion to this release. |

Keep each disk edition's files together on a disk/SD/CF directory. Supply your
own operating system when needed; reset to exit the game. Standard RAM mapper,
MegaRAM and cartridge banking are distinct hardware interfaces. A512 KiB
MegaRAM is insufficient. The experimental512 KiB RAM backend is **not included
as a final download**.

**Controls:** 5 credit; 1 one player; 2 alternating two-player game (two credits);
arrows/joystick1 steering; Space/Ctrl/triggerA smoke; P pause.

**Test invulnerability:** hold **F10** through the ROM/RAM opening until the
title, then release before credit/start. On an MSX keyboard this is
**Shift+F5**. Cars and rocks cannot kill; walls remain solid. Reset clears the
mode. The repository's openMSX launcher binds host F10 to the MSX combination.

## Changes and validation

- Smaller pooled maps/render resources, corrected original RNG/flag lifecycle,
  and the fixed-RAM world binding retain the complete game below768 KiB.
- Cartridge and both MegaRAM launchers pass genuine fixed64 KiB profiles with
  **zero RAM mapper devices**. Separate/shared primary slots and unexpanded
  RAM are covered. Existing expanded caches and supported CPU acceleration
  remain available on machines that provide them.
- Ten performance comparisons match356 camera/actor/input/tick/full-PSG rows
  per workload. No paired active frame is slower within0.01 reference-cycle
  tolerance. WSX fixed64 presentation is30.029 /28.872 /28.817 FPS with3/5/6
  native enemies, at59.922743 Hz refresh. Existing heavy-scene tails remain;
  this is not a sustained30-FPS promise for every scene.
-4096 native steps match original state, all14 PSG registers and host state in
  cartridge and MegaRAM. Opening, audio/PCM, flags/clear, challenge, two-player,
  radar, smoke, controls and sprite clipping checks pass.
-16,000-refresh turn/keyboard/smoke stress, natural game over/title/new game,
  F10 keyboard/reset/contact-handler cases and DOS/BASIC loading pass.
-512 general tests and94 component tests pass, one component skipped. The
  frozen source-module byte/symbol layout gate passes. Main-mapper executable
  bytes are preserved; its ZIP metadata/source overlay can differ on repacking.

The qualification JSON records measurements taken while this exact artifact was
still a local candidate. The owner approved its promotion on2026-11-18. These
are automated/openMSX22 NTSC results; physical hardware, PAL50 and subjective
listening are separate from this publication approval. The earlier experimental
512 KiB route-timing question is not declared solved by this release.

`c3736f2cc167638a7e90e4919c6d12f6268be3ca4c6cbc9ccd710a5360d84fd6`.

Verify all downloads with **SHA256SUMS**. This release's Git tag includes the
authored build tools, contracts, tests, reports and timing workbook. No source
overlay is needed over the automatic source archive. Supply your original
arcade inputs under `references/roms/nrallyx/` and run `make build` or
`make build-megaram`; see `docs/building.md`. Original arcade inputs, extracted
assets, BIOS, operating systems and experimental512 KiB binaries are excluded
from the source tree.
